Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.social
Use cases of social login (identity brokering): resolving a sign-in with an external provider to an account (finding it, linking by verified e-mail address, or provisioning it), linking, unlinking and listing the identities of an account.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.social
JDBC adapters of social login: the identities of external providers linked to accounts, the mark of the accounts that only hold a generated password, and the Jackson module of the federated principals.
